_comment: Wave 133-135 — secondary Action economy (env-gated SWEG_SECONDARY). REBUILD (wave 135): the wave-133 gate on POSITION-card scoring (Engage on All Fronts / Behind Enemy Lines) was reverted because those are POSITIONAL Secondaries scored on presence/occupancy with no Action and no 'dedication' requirement (and the A/B confirmed gating them backfired). The rules-clean low-unit penalty now lives on the ACTION cards (Cleanse / Sabotage): performing an Action genuinely costs a unit its shooting and charge for the turn (the 10e Actions core rule), so a low-unit army that needs every body fighting cannot spare one and scores those cards 0 — EMERGENT from unit count, no faction branch, no model-count branch. The simulator.secondary_dedication key below now documents the surviving dedication PLANNER as a movement/positioning bias only; the Action-cost rule is simulator.secondary_action_cost. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/core-rules/ (Actions) cross-checked vs the Chapter Approved 2025-26 deck (the deck the May-2026 calibration target was played under). The data/reference/wahapedia_ca2025-26.txt reference file was not present in this environment, so the Action framing is taken from the 10e Actions core rule on Wahapedia, consistent with the existing secondaries_pariah_nexus.json Cleanse/Sabotage citations.

simulator.secondary_action_cost.source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/core-rules/#Actions (10e core 'Actions' rule; cross-checked vs the Chapter Approved 2025-26 / Pariah Nexus Action Mission cards Cleanse and Sabotage on https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/pariah-nexus-battles/ . The data/reference/wahapedia_ca2025-26.txt reference file was absent in this build, so the Action contract is sourced from the 10e Actions core rule on Wahapedia.)
simulator.secondary_action_cost.rule_name: Actions cost the unit its shooting and charge for the turn (10e core Actions)
simulator.secondary_action_cost.quoted_text: Some rules instruct a unit to start to perform an action. In order to start to perform an action, a unit must be eligible to shoot in your Shooting phase. Until the start of your next turn, that unit is performing that action and cannot shoot or declare a charge. If a unit that is performing an action is destroyed, or does anything that prevents it from performing that action (e.g. it is no longer eligible to shoot because it is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit), the action immediately ends and is not completed. An action is completed (and its effects applied) at the time specified by that action's rules — typically at the end of your turn.
simulator.secondary_action_cost.trigger: the active army's Movement-phase Action declaration (Battle._assign_cleanse_actions / _assign_sabotage_actions, after the move loop): a unit may START Cleanse / Sabotage only if it passes the Action contract (Battle._unit_can_perform_action) — alive, not already acting this round, Objective Control > 0, NOT within Engagement Range (~1.5") of any enemy, and NOT a productive shooter with a target in range (attacks * hit_probability * weapon_damage_per_shot >= 2.0 AND an enemy within weapon range). The unit is then flagged Unit.action_this_round, which locks it out of shooting (Battle._do_shoot) and charging (Battle._do_charge) for the turn.
simulator.secondary_action_cost.effect: Performing Cleanse / Sabotage costs a unit its shooting and its charge for the turn; the Action scores only if the unit COMPLETES it — it survives to end of turn and was not dragged into Engagement Range (Battle._action_completes), re-confirmed by the per-card scorer (_score_cleanse / _score_sabotage), which also re-checks Objective Control. A low-unit durable army (e.g. a Knight) cannot spare a unit to forgo shooting/charging for an Action, so it scores Cleanse / Sabotage 0; a broad army with spare non-shooting bodies does. EMERGENT from unit count and the shoot/charge opportunity cost — NO faction branch, NO model-count branch, NO Knight penalty. Env-gated SWEG_SECONDARY (default OFF); the OFF path keeps the legacy chaff-selection / still-alive scoring byte-for-byte.

simulator.secondary_dedication.source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/chapter-approved-2025-26/ (Chapter Approved 2025-26 deck — the deck the May-2026 calibration target was played under. The data/reference/wahapedia_ca2025-26.txt reference file was absent in this build, so the framing is taken from the CA-2025-26 secondary-mission scoring step plus the 10e Actions core rule.)
simulator.secondary_dedication.rule_name: Dedication positioning bias for held position Secondaries (AI movement heuristic)
simulator.secondary_dedication.quoted_text: Engage on All Fronts and Behind Enemy Lines are positional Secondary Missions: they are scored at the end of your turn for the table quarters you occupy / for your units in the opponent's deployment zone — no action is performed and no 'dedication' is declared. (Per-card scoring text is cited verbatim under simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts and simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines; the positional scoring path passes the full unit list and is not gated on dedication.)
simulator.secondary_dedication.trigger: the active TACTICAL army's Movement phase: the dedication planner (Battle._assign_card_dedication) peels ONE SPARE unit per held position card and biases its move (Unit.pursue_target) toward the card's geographic goal — the opponent's deployment-zone midpoint for Behind Enemy Lines, an unoccupied table quarter's centre for Engage on All Fronts. A unit is SPARE per Battle._unit_is_dedicatable (alive, not acted, not already dedicated, not holding an objective, not in melee, not a productive shooter with a target in range).
simulator.secondary_dedication.effect: POSITIONING BIAS ONLY: the planner nudges a spare unit toward a card's geography so the army spreads / projects forward; the resulting occupancy is then scored incidentally by the unchanged positional scorer. Unit.dedicated_card is NOT read by any scoring path (the wave-133 scoring gate was reverted as unfaithful — positional Secondaries score on presence, not a performed action). The even-handed effect is emergent: a Knight with no spare body cannot spread and so incidentally occupies fewer quarters, with NO fabricated scoring gate. NO faction awareness, NO model-count branch. Env-gated SWEG_SECONDARY (default OFF); OFF path sets no bias and is byte-identical. The rules-clean low-unit penalty lives on the Action cards (simulator.secondary_action_cost), not here.
